picks.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 4.1% in October?
picks.why: A rising jobless rate would signal a cooling labor market and shape the Fed's next moves on interest rates.

picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: Inflation above 4.5 percent would erode real wages and could force tighter monetary policy despite slowing growth.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global oil, so disrupted traffic directly affects energy prices and inflation.

picks.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Leadership in frontier AI shapes where investment, talent and productivity gains concentrate across the technology sector.

picks.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: An AI-produced solution to a famous unsolved math problem would mark a major leap in machine reasoning capabilities.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state-level wealth tax would test whether taxing large fortunes raises revenue or prompts wealthy residents to relocate.
